Hero.subtitle1: Lenix traces stolen and misdirected crypto, settles to fiat across supported corridors, lends against vaulted collateral, and runs monitoring for asset-holding teams.
Hero.subtitle2: Each workflow has its own intake and deliverables. On recovery, we assess the trail before paid engagement—we do not promise outcomes.

Overview.title: Match the problem to the workflow
Overview.description: Most visitors already know whether they need tracing, a payout, liquidity, or operational controls. Skim the summaries, then open the section that fits.

recovery.title: Asset recovery
recovery.desc: Funds were stolen, scammed, or sent to the wrong address. You need a trace and documented evidence before deciding on next steps.

payments.title: Cross-border payments
payments.desc: Treasury or finance needs crypto converted to fiat, with rates, fees, and delivery status they can show auditors.

lending.title: Crypto lending
lending.desc: You hold eligible collateral and need liquidity without selling the position outright.

security.title: Platform security
security.desc: Your team custodies client assets and needs monitoring, access rules, and a written escalation path.

Recovery.title: Trace first. Engage only when a path exists.
Recovery.description: Submit wallet addresses, transaction hashes, and a short timeline. We follow where value moved, prepare findings for exchanges and counsel, and say plainly if recovery is realistic before any paid engagement. We do not promise recovery.

points.chains: Tracing on major EVM networks, Bitcoin, and stablecoins commonly seen in theft cases
points.evidence: Documentation formatted for exchange compliance desks, counsel, and law enforcement
points.terms: Scope and fees set only after a free recoverability review

Payments.title: Settlement your treasury can audit
Payments.description: Convert crypto to fiat where local banking rails are slow, expensive, or opaque. Rate, fee, and status are visible from wallet initiation through beneficiary delivery — so finance and ops are not guessing.

corridors.title: Active corridors
corridors.desc: Payout to bank accounts in markets we support today. Contact us if your corridor is not listed.

visibility.title: Handoff tracking
visibility.desc: Status at each step of the flow, not a single pending flag with no context.

compliance.title: Sanctions and AML screening
compliance.desc: Inbound and outbound flows screened before funds are released.

Lending.title: Liquidity while collateral stays in vault
Lending.description: Post approved collateral and draw stablecoins or fiat. LTV, repayment terms, and liquidation thresholds are shown before disbursement — no hidden triggers after you sign.

points.credit: Eligible collateral types do not require a traditional credit check
points.ltv: LTV and repayment schedules agreed upfront
points.custody: Collateral held in segregated vaults for the loan term

Security.title: Controls for teams that custody client assets
Security.description: Wallet monitoring, permissioned access, and incident escalation for organizations that cannot treat suspicious activity as a back-burner ticket. Built for ops teams, not slide-deck security.

monitoring.title: Activity monitoring
monitoring.desc: Alerts on unusual outflows, new counterparties, and transfers outside policy.

access.title: Access and audit trail
access.desc: Role-based permissions with a record of who approved what and when.

incident.title: Incident response
incident.desc: Written escalation steps your team can run when activity needs human review.

Cta.title: Not sure which workflow applies?
Cta.description: Describe the situation — lost funds, a payout, a loan, or an ops concern — and we will route you to the right intake.
